Generate a CRPS calculating function based on a parametrised distribution name

Source: R/scoring.R
crps_fn_generator.Rd

scoringRules has implementations of common functions but not so much for re-parametrisations. This detects if a re-parametrisation is available for a distribution name and remaps the input to a more common distribution that scoringRules has support for.

Usage

crps_fn_generator(dist_name)

Arguments

dist_name

the name of the distribution, e.g. norm, lnorm4

Value

a function which takes 3 parameters: true_value, location, and scale and returns a CRPS for them.

Unit tests



fn=crps_fn_generator("lnorm4")
mapped = fn(1:5,1,2)
tmp = .reparam.lnorm4(1,2)
direct = scoringRules::crps(1:5, tmp$dist, meanlog = tmp$meanlog, sdlog = tmp$sdlog)
testthat::expect_equal(mapped, direct)
